description: This script generates a production plan summary report in the ERPNext system, fetching and organizing data related to work orders, purchase orders, and BOMs for manufacturing planning.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles production plan data.

methods.name: get_production_plan_item_details
methods.description: Retrieves details of production plan items and appends to data.

methods.name: get_production_plan_sub_assembly_item_details
methods.description: Retrieves sub-assembly items related to production plan and appends to data.

methods.name: get_work_order_details
methods.description: Fetches work order details for the given production plan.

methods.name: get_purchase_order_details
methods.description: Fetches purchase order item details for the production plan.

methods.name: get_column
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.
